pdac_pt01_gemcitabine_resistant.title: Patient PT-01: Classical Gemcitabine Resistant PDAC
pdac_pt01_gemcitabine_resistant.citation: Tiriac et al. (2018) Cancer Discovery; TCGA-PAAD Case #1

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Progression at 4.2 months, deceased at 7.1 months (Chemoresistant)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Intrinsic apoptotic block; high baseline EGFR and MEK survival loops

pdac_pt02_folfirinox_refractory.title: Patient PT-02: FOLFIRINOX Refractory PI3K-Hyperactive PDAC
pdac_pt02_folfirinox_refractory.citation: Eduati et al. (2020) Mol. Syst. Biol. Biopsy PT02

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Completely refractory to platinum chemotherapy; progression at 3.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Constitutive AKT/mTOR metabolic survival bypassing DNA-damage apoptosis

pdac_pt03_smad4_metastatic.title: Patient PT-03: SMAD4-Deleted Aggressive Liver Metastatic PDAC
pdac_pt03_smad4_metastatic.citation: Tiriac et al. (2018) Cancer Discovery; TCGA-PAAD Case #3

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Rapid hepatic metastatic storm within 90 days; death at 5.5 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Loss of TGF-beta tumor suppression; compensatory STAT3 and MCL1 shielding

pdac_pt04_erlotinib_relapsed.title: Patient PT-04: Erlotinib Targeted Therapy Relapsed PDAC
pdac_pt04_erlotinib_relapsed.citation: Eduati et al. (2020) Biopsy PT04; Moore et al. (2007) JCO

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Transient partial response for 3 months, followed by lethal relapse at 6.4 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: XIAP downstream checkpoint blocked caspase execution despite EGFR suppression

pdac_pt05_folfirinox_responder.title: Patient PT-05: Exceptional FOLFIRINOX Long-Term Survivor
pdac_pt05_folfirinox_responder.citation: TCGA-PAAD Long-Term Survivor Cohort; Tiriac et al. (2018)

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete clinical response; disease-free survival >28 months (SURVIVED)
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Functional p53 apoptotic priming; vulnerable to DNA damage

pdac_pt06_hypoxic_avascular.title: Patient PT-06: Avascular Dense Desmoplastic Core PDAC
pdac_pt06_hypoxic_avascular.citation: Eduati et al. (2020) Biopsy PT06; Provenzano et al. (Cancer Cell)

clinical_history.primary_driver: KRAS-G12D, TP53-mut, High interstitial fluid pressure
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Severe hypoperfusion prevented drug delivery; progression at 3.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Hypoxic metabolic adaptation via NF-kB and mTOR; apoptosis silence

pdac_pt07_cytokine_cachexia.title: Patient PT-07: High-Inflammatory Cytokine Storm & Cachexia PDAC
pdac_pt07_cytokine_cachexia.citation: Tiriac et al. (2018) Case #7; Fearon et al. (Cell 2012)

clinical_history.primary_driver: KRAS-G12D, High circulating TNF-alpha and IL-6, TP53-mut
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Severe chemotherapy toxicity, early discontinuation at 2 months, death at 4.8 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Constitutive NF-kB driving MCL1 and BCL-xL; massive anti-apoptotic shield

pdac_pt08_myc_amplified.title: Patient PT-08: Highly Proliferative MYC-Amplified PDAC
pdac_pt08_myc_amplified.citation: TCGA-PAAD Case #8; Witkiewicz et al. (2015) Nat. Commun.

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Doubling time <3 weeks; fulminant progression, deceased at 4.1 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: High ERK and Cyclin D signaling continuously overcoming cell-cycle arrest

pdac_pt09_trail_insensitive.title: Patient PT-09: Extrinsic Death Receptor Refractory PDAC
pdac_pt09_trail_insensitive.citation: Eduati et al. (2020) Biopsy PT09; Stanger et al.

clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Complete insensitivity to extrinsic apoptosis triggers; death at 6.0 months
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: c-FLIP blocks Caspase-8; XIAP blocks Caspase-3/9

pdac_pt10_mitochondrial_shield.title: Patient PT-10: Mitochondrial Redundancy Multi-Drug Resistant PDAC
pdac_pt10_mitochondrial_shield.citation: TCGA-PAAD Case #10; Leverson et al. (Cancer Cell)

clinical_history.primary_driver: KRAS-G12D, TP53-mut, Co-expression of BCL-2, BCL-xL, and MCL-1
clinical_history.real_world_outcome: Slow disease progression, refractory to all conventional cytotoxic agents
clinical_history.known_resistance_mechanism: Triple redundancy on mitochondrial outer membrane prevents BAX/BAK pore opening
